visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short brown hair, wearing a green t-shirt, speaks directly to the camera in a bright indoor room. Behind him is a wide computer monitor displaying professional video editing software (Premiere Pro) with bicycle racing footage on the timeline. (2) The scene cuts to outdoor race footage on a rainy day; cyclists are pedaling through a narrow countryside road lined with stone walls and green foliage. (3) A middle-aged man with glasses is driving a car, seen from an interior perspective; he is animatedly cheering out the window while a cyclist in a distinctive red, white, and blue stars-and-stripes jersey rides alongside. (4) A man with long blonde hair and a beard, wearing a blue athletic jacket, walks past a large blue 'Lidl-Trek' team bus carrying a white paper bag. (5) High-speed racing shots show multiple cyclists in a pack; the rider in the stars-and-stripes jersey stands out as he corners through city streets. (6) Close-up shots feature the bicycle frame with 'SIMMONS' text and the bottom bracket area with 'TRIPEAK' branding. (7) The blonde cyclist is shown in a formal indoor setting, wearing a black shirt and speaking into a microphone on a stage. (8) He is later seen at a table, interacting with people and signing a colorful cycling jersey for a fan.

(2) A transition whoosh SFX occurs, followed by the introduction of a driving, epic cinematic rock BGM with a strong drum beat and synth layers. (3) A man's voice is heard shouting 'Go Quinn!' with significant vocal strain and excitement, competing with the engine hum of a car and outdoor wind noise. (4) The BGM continues as a central layer while outdoor ambient sounds like a bus engine idling and muffled background chatter are audible. (5) A sharp whistle SFX triggers, followed by high-pitched mechanical whirring from bicycle hubs and the sound of crowds cheering loudly. (6) A different male voice is heard speaking through a public address system with noticeable indoor reverb, delivering a calm and reflective narrative. (7) The track concludes with the BGM swelling alongside the sounds of light crowd applause and incidental movement noises.
